test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I wish we had ______ come here.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence expresses** a wish about a past action, indicating regret or a desire that something had not happened.**
 
• The word **"never"** is appropriate in this context as it correctly conveys the speaker's regret about coming to the place.
 
• Other options like **"right," "clear,"** and **"agreed" **do not fit the context of the sentence and do not convey the intended meaning of regret or wish.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *I wish we had **never** come here*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word** "never"** is often used in sentences that express a wish or regret about something that did not happen in the past.
 
• It is important to choose words that correctly convey the intended meaning and fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
